intro: City of dreams, City of endless possibilities—New York never sleeps, and neither will your excitement as you explore its iconic landmarks and hidden gems. From the dazzling lights of Times Square to the serene beauty of Central Park, the city offers a unique blend of urban energy and green retreats. Marriott Bonvoy’s hotels in New York are strategically located to bring you closer to the heart of it all, whether you’re here for business or a family trip. Each property is designed to offer comfort, luxury, and the convenience you need to make the most of your stay.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: While New York City is famous for its towering skyscrapers and bustling streets, it is also home to a number of parks and natural areas that many don't think or know about. Central Park, an 843-acre urban oasis, is the perfect place to relax with its large meadows, quiet bodies of water, and carefully landscaped gardens. You can rent a rowboat to paddle across The Lake, take a horse-drawn carriage ride, or simply have a picnic. The High Line is a more peaceful alternative, an elevated park built on a historic freight rail line. It features beautiful gardens, public art, and views of the Hudson River, and is a great place to take a leisurely walk.

Urban nature enthusiasts will also appreciate the Brooklyn Botanic Garden, which offers 52 acres of beautiful gardens and peaceful places to relax. From the cherry blossoms in the Japanese Hill-and-Pond Garden to the vibrant rose gardens, this is a great place to visit year-round. If you’re willing to travel a bit further, the Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge, part of Gateway National Recreation Area, is a great place to go bird watching or take nature photos. With its many types of wildlife and different types of habitats, you can get a nice break from the hustle and bustle of the city.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: The culture of New York City is a dynamic tapestry woven from the threads of its diverse neighborhoods and the myriad of influences of its residents. Staying at one of our hotels in NYC places you at the epicenter of this vibrant cultural mosaic, where you can explore world-renowned museums like the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Museum of Modern Art, each offering a glimpse into the past and a vision of the future. The city’s historic neighborhoods, such as Greenwich Village and Harlem, are alive with the spirit of the arts, music, and literature, inviting you to experience the places where legends were born and movements took shape. After a day of cultural immersion, retreat to the comfort and style of your Marriott Bonvoy accommodations, where the city’s energy is reflected in every detail.

New York City’s cultural offerings extend far beyond its iconic museums and historic districts. The city is a global center for the performing arts, with Broadway shows that dazzle audiences from around the world and off-Broadway productions that push creative boundaries. For a more intimate experience, visit one of the city’s many art galleries and studios, or take in a performance at the Lincoln Center, where classical music, opera and dance come together. The city’s street art and murals, particularly in neighborhoods like Bushwick and the Lower East Side, offer a unique perspective on its ever-evolving cultural landscape. Whether you’re a seasoned art enthusiast or a curious traveler, New York City’s cultural offerings are sure to inspire and delight.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: New York City is a city of seasons, and its weather can change with the blink of an eye. Summer, from June to August, is warm and humid, with average temperatures ranging from the mid-70s to mid-80s Fahrenheit. But don’t be surprised if you experience a heatwave, with temperatures soaring into the 90s. When the weather gets hot, you can cool off in the comfort of air-conditioned Marriott Bonvoy hotels. Summer is also the wettest time of year, with frequent thunderstorms and scattered showers. But don’t let that put a damper on your plans. The rain helps keep Central Park and other green spaces in the city lush and beautiful.

Winters in the city, from December to February, are cold, with temperatures often hovering in the 30s and 40s Fahrenheit. Snowfall can vary, but the city typically receives around 25 to 30 inches of snow annually, creating a picturesque winter wonderland, especially in areas like Times Square and Central Park. Spring and fall are milder, with temperatures ranging from the 50s to the 70s, making these seasons ideal for exploring the city’s vibrant neighborhoods and outdoor attractions. The crisp fall air and vibrant foliage, along with the blooming flowers of spring, add a seasonal charm to the city’s bustling streets and scenic parks that you can enjoy from any of our New York City hotels.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: Visitors to New York City have an array of transportation options to choose from, ensuring easy access to the city's vibrant neighborhoods and attractions. Many travelers arrive at one of the city's major airports: John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, or Newark Liberty International Airport. From there, a variety of services are available to reach your Marriott Bonvoy hotel, including taxis, ride-sharing apps like Uber and Lyft, and the AirTrain, which connects to the city's extensive subway system. Some hotels also offer complimentary shuttle services, providing an added convenience for guests.

Once you're in the city, the subway is a fast and efficient way to get around, with 24/7 service and stations located throughout New York City. Buses and bike-sharing programs like Citi Bike offer flexible options for shorter trips, and walking is a great way to explore the streets of Manhattan, particularly in areas like Midtown and the Financial District. For a more leisurely journey, hop-on-hop-off sightseeing buses and water taxis provide scenic routes and a unique perspective of the city. Whether you're headed to Central Park, the Brooklyn Bridge or Times Square, New York City's diverse transportation options make it easy to get around and see all the city has to offer.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: New York City is a playground for kids of all ages. Start your family adventure at the American Museum of Natural History, where kids can explore dinosaur fossils, interactive exhibits, and even a planetarium that brings the cosmos to life. For a more playful experience, Central Park offers endless possibilities, from the iconic Central Park Zoo, with its charming penguins and monkeys, to the sprawling lawns and iconic playgrounds that are perfect for running and climbing. The city’s vibrant energy and iconic landmarks make every day an adventure and you'll be close to it all in one of our local family-friendly properties.

For those families looking to add a little creativity to their trip, the Children’s Museum of the Arts is the perfect place for kids to get hands-on with art activities and view inspiring exhibits. The Brooklyn Children’s Museum is also a sweet spot for those with a sweet tooth, offering chocolate-making workshops. And the New York Transit Museum, located in a decommissioned subway station, is a unique way to experience the city’s transportation history, with vintage subway cars to explore. With so many family-friendly activities, New York City is sure to provide a memorable experience for everyone.

intro: Boston, a city that marries the past with the future, offers a compelling mix of history and innovation. From the charming streets of the North End to the dynamic Seaport District, every part of Boston has a story to tell. Marriott Bonvoy’s collection of hotels in Boston is perfectly positioned for your exploration, with properties near key attractions like the Freedom Trail, Fenway Park, and the Boston Common. No matter why you are visiting, the city's rich heritage and lively ambiance are certain to leave a lasting impression. And many Marriott Bonvoy hotels offer complimentary amenities like free Wi-Fi and fitness centers, ensuring your stay is as comfortable as it is exciting.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Boston is a city where nature and urban life harmonize, offering a plethora of green spaces and outdoor activities for every type of explorer. The historic Boston Common, the nation's first public park, is a delightful place for a casual stroll, a picnic, or an impromptu game of frisbee. Just moments away, the Public Garden allures with its beautifully landscaped lawns, ponds, and the famous swan boats, providing a peaceful oasis amidst the city's hustle and bustle. Those in search of a more extensive natural haven can venture to the Arnold Arboretum, a living museum of trees and plants, which boasts miles of trails for hiking and botanical discovery.

Boston is a water lover’s paradise, with the Charles River and the city’s coastal areas offering a variety of activities. The Esplanade, a beautiful park that runs along the Charles River, is perfect for jogging, biking, or simply taking in the views. In the summer, you can rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore the river’s calm waters. For a day at the beach, head to Castle Island, where you can explore the historic Fort Independence and enjoy a picnic by the sea.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: The culture in Boston is a vibrant city rooted in its storied past and driven by its forward-thinking. Staying at one of our hotels in Boston places you at the center of this dynamic city, where you can easily explore the Freedom Trail, a 2.5-mile path that winds through 16 historically significant sites, each telling a piece of the city’s revolutionary story. From the Old North Church to the USS Constitution, the trail offers a firsthand look at the landmarks that shaped the nation. After a day of history, unwind in the comfort of our Boston hotels, complete with modern amenities and a warm, inviting atmosphere.

Boston's cultural landscape is equally compelling, with its many museums and institutions offering a rich tapestry of art and history. The Museum of Fine Arts is a treasure trove, showcasing masterpieces from across the world, including iconic American and European works. For a literary journey, the Boston Athenaeum and the historic Beacon Hill district, once home to the likes of Louisa May Alcott and Henry David Thoreau, beckon. Whether your interests lie in the past or the present, Boston's cultural scene is sure to captivate with its diverse and enriching offerings.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Boston is a city of four seasons, and each one is more beautiful than the last. The city experiences a humid continental climate, with warm summers, cold winters, and pleasant spring and fall seasons. Summer, from June to August, is warm and humid, with average high temperatures in the mid-70s to low 80s. This is the perfect time to visit the city's many parks and gardens, such as the Boston Common and the Public Garden, or to take a leisurely stroll along the waterfront. While the city is prone to thunderstorms and heat waves, most hotels offer air-conditioned rooms and pool facilities to keep you comfortable.

In Boston, winter runs from December to February. Temperatures are cold, with average lows in the mid-20s to low 30s F. Snowfall varies widely, but the city is prepared for snow with efficient snow removal and heated transportation options. This makes it easy to enjoy winter festivals and holiday markets. Fall and Spring, from September to November and March to May, are mild and pleasant. Fall is especially beautiful, with vibrant foliage. Spring is a time of new life, with blooming flowers and trees.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: When you visit Boston, you have many choices for getting around, from the subway to buses, water taxis, and more. The city is also very walkable, and it’s easy to find a taxi or rideshare service like Uber or Lyft. Logan International Airport is the main gateway for most visitors, and it’s easy to get to and from the airport to your accommodations. If you’re arriving by train, Boston is also served by Amtrak and MBTA commuter rail, making it easy to get to and from the city from other parts of the region.

Once you're in Boston, the MBTA, or "the T," is the city's public transportation system, offering subway, bus, and commuter rail services that reach throughout the city and its suburbs. The T is an efficient and affordable way to get around, with many Marriott Bonvoy hotels located within walking distance of T stations. For more direct and flexible travel, taxis and ride-sharing services are available throughout the city. Boston is also a highly walkable city, especially in the historic downtown area, so it's easy to explore sites like the Freedom Trail and Quincy Market on foot. If you prefer to rent a car, there are several rental agencies located at the airport and throughout the city.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Boston is a city full of fun for the whole family, with great activities that will engage and entertain kids of all ages. The Museum of Science is a must-see, with its hands-on exhibits, interactive experiments, and even a butterfly garden. The Paul Revere House is a great place to learn a little bit of history and see what life was like in colonial times, with period furniture and great storytelling that will keep kids interested. The New England Aquarium is another great place for families, where kids can see all kinds of marine life, touch some of the animals, and learn about conservation.

Boston’s vast green spaces, such as the Boston Common and the Public Garden, are perfect for outdoor activities, from running and playing to swan boat rides. The Franklin Park Zoo is another great place to visit, with a variety of animals and interactive exhibits that will keep your little ones entertained. After a day of exploring, head to the USS Constitution Museum, where kids can try on sailor costumes, play games, and learn about the famous "Old Ironsides." With family-friendly hotels throughout Boston, you’re never far from the city’s top attractions, so you can make the most of your time in Boston and create lasting memories with your family.

intro: Chicago, a city celebrated for its architectural wonders and rich cultural tapestry, extends a warm welcome with a blend of heritage and modernity. From the towering Willis Tower to the lush expanse of Millennium Park and the revered Art Institute, the city's iconic landmarks beckon you to explore and be inspired. Marriott Bonvoy’s collection of hotels in Chicago offers the perfect launchpad for your adventures, with prime locations near key attractions and amenities that ensure your comfort and convenience. Whether your visit is for business or leisure, the city's vibrant energy combined with our hotels' attentive service will create an unforgettable experience.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Chicago is a city that has it all, from the hustle and bustle of downtown to the tranquility of its many parks and green spaces. Whether you’re making the drive to the nearby Indiana Dunes National Park, relaxing on the 12th Stree Beach, or you’re taking a peaceful stroll through the North Pond Nature Sanctuary, you’ll find something to love. Lincoln Park, one of the largest parks in the city, covers 1,200 acres and offers a wide variety of outdoor activities. The park also has several trails for jogging, cycling, or walking, and its beaches along Lake Michigan are perfect for sunbathing or swimming. If you’re looking for a more immersive natural experience, you might want to check out the Chicago Botanic Garden in nearby Glencoe. The garden has 385 acres of beautiful gardens and natural landscapes to explore.

The city’s lakefront trail, an 18-mile path along Lake Michigan, is a must-see for outdoor enthusiasts. This trail connects several parks and beaches, offering stunning views of the skyline and the lake. Whether you’re on a bike, a run, or a leisurely stroll, the trail provides a refreshing escape from the bustling city. Additionally, the Chicago Riverwalk, a 1.25-mile pedestrian path along the Chicago River, is a hidden gem where you can enjoy the water, grab a bite at one of the many riverside eateries, or take a boat tour to see the city from a different perspective. These natural spaces in Chicago ensure that there’s always a place to reconnect with nature, no matter where you are in the city.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: Chicago's culture is as diverse as its neighborhoods, each with its own unique flavor and a story to tell. From the historic jazz and blues clubs of Bronzeville to the iconic art deco skyscrapers in the Loop, the city is a living, breathing museum of its own rich history and modern innovation. When you stay at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel in Chicago, you're never far from the city's cultural touchstones, like the Chicago History Museum, where you can dive into the stories that have shaped the city, or Millennium Park, home to the iconic Cloud Gate (The Bean).

Chicago’s arts and culture scene is as diverse as it is dynamic. World-renowned institutions like the Art Institute of Chicago and the Museum of Contemporary Art exhibit both classic and cutting-edge works. The city’s theaters, from the grand stages of the Broadway in Chicago venues to the intimate, experimental spaces of the Off-Loop theater district, offer a range of performances to cater to every taste. Whether you’re catching a show at the Steppenwolf Theatre or exploring the vibrant murals and street art in Pilsen, Chicago’s creative spirit is sure to leave a lasting impression. After a day of exploring, return to the modern comforts of your hotel, complete with on-site dining and fitness centers.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Chicago’s climate is a tale of four seasons, each with its own unique allure. Summers are warm and can be quite humid, with temperatures typically hovering between the mid-70s and mid-80s Fahrenheit, and occasionally spiking into the 90s. It's the ideal time to savor the city's outdoor offerings, from lakeside strolls to music festivals in Grant Park. Don't be surprised by the occasional thunderstorm or passing shower—they're a welcome reprieve from the heat. Many of our Chicago hotels are well-equipped for the warm season, with air-conditioned rooms and rooftop bars to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Chicago's winter months can be quite cold, with temperatures ranging from the mid-20s to the mid-30s. Snow is a common sight, and the cityscape, especially its iconic skyline and the river, is transformed into a winter wonderland. But don't let the chill deter you—Chicago's indoor attractions, from museums to theaters, are bustling, and the holiday markets are a must-see. Spring and fall are milder, with spring temperatures averaging in the 50s to 70s and fall in the 40s to 60s. These seasons are perfect for exploring the city's parks and gardens, each offering a unique experience with blossoming flowers in spring and stunning foliage in fall. No matter the season, Marriott Bonvoy hotels offer the perfect home base to experience Chicago's ever-changing climate and its many seasonal attractions.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: When you arrive in Chicago, you’ll find a variety of transportation options to get you to your local Marriott Bonvoy hotel with ease. Chicago O’Hare International Airport and Midway International Airport are the city’s major gateways, serving domestic and international flights. From the airports, you can take a taxi, ride-sharing service like Uber or Lyft, or the Chicago Transit Authority (CTA) public transit system to your hotel. Some Marriott Bonvoy hotels also offer complimentary shuttle service to and from O’Hare, making your travel experience even more convenient.

Once you've landed in Chicago, getting around is a breeze. The city's extensive CTA network includes the iconic “L” trains and a comprehensive bus system. The “L” trains connect all major neighborhoods and attractions, making it an efficient and affordable way to explore the city. For those who prefer more personalized travel, taxis and ride-sharing services are readily available, and several rental car agencies operate throughout the city, including at both airports. Chicago’s grid-like street layout and well-marked pedestrian walkways also make it an excellent city for walking, especially in the bustling downtown area. Whether you’re heading to the Magnificent Mile, the Loop, or the scenic lakefront, Chicago’s diverse transportation options ensure you can reach your destination with ease.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Chicago is a treasure trove of kid-friendly attractions that will keep the whole family entertained. Start your adventure at the Museum of Science and Industry, where interactive exhibits like the coal mine and the U-505 submarine offer thrilling hands-on experiences. The Shedd Aquarium is another must-visit, with its vast array of marine life and engaging shows that will captivate young minds. For a fun day out, head to Maggie Daley Park, which features a fantastic playground, an ice skating ribbon, and mini-golf courses that are perfect for all ages.

Families can also experience the wonder of Chicago’s cultural institutions. The Art Institute of Chicago offers a Family Room where children can create their own art. The Lincoln Park Zoo, one of the last remaining free zoos in the country, is home to a wide variety of animals and offers educational programs that are both fun and informative. After a day of exploration, enjoy a slice of Chicago’s famous deep-dish pizza or a sweet treat from the Original Rainbow Cone. With so much to see and do, Chicago is the perfect place for a family vacation and one of our hotels in Chicago is happy to your family's local home.

intro: San Francisco, a city that needs no introduction, is a breathtaking blend of iconic landmarks, historic neighborhoods, and cutting-edge innovation. From the world-renowned Golden Gate Bridge to the lively Fisherman’s Wharf, the city by the bay is a treasure trove of must-see attractions. Our collection of Marriott Bonvoy’s hotels in San Francisco offers the perfect home base for exploring the city’s diverse neighborhoods, from the colorful Haight-Ashbury to the tech-centric South of Market (SoMa). Each of our properties is designed to provide you with the comfort and convenience you need for a seamless stay, whether you’re here for business or leisure.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: San Francisco’s natural splendor is a living tribute to the city's rich tapestry of ecosystems and breathtaking landscapes. Golden Gate Park, an urban expanse of over 1,000 acres, beckons with its gardens, lakes, and meandering paths, offering a serene respite from the city's bustling pace. The park is graced by the renowned Japanese Tea Garden, the oldest of its kind in the United States, where you can lose yourself in the tranquility of traditional architecture. For those with a spirit of adventure, the Presidio, once a military post and now a national park, invites exploration with its network of trails, historic sites, and panoramic vistas of the Golden Gate Bridge and the Pacific Ocean.

Just a short drive from the city, Muir Woods National Monument is the perfect place to see some of the tallest and oldest coastal redwoods in the world. The park’s well-maintained trails allow you to get up close and personal with these giants, immersing you in the lush, green canopy and the cool, misty air. Back in San Francisco, the waterfront along the Embarcadero and the scenic paths of Lands End offer stunning views and a chance to see the city’s unique blend of urban and natural environments. Whether you’re a seasoned hiker or a casual nature lover, San Francisco’s outdoor spaces offer endless opportunities to connect with nature and recharge.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: San Francisco's culture is a rich tapestry of the city's diverse communities and historical landmarks. Marriott Bonvoy's collection of hotels in San Francisco offer the perfect home base to explore this unique blend, with amenities that embody the city's cosmopolitan spirit. Our hotels make it easy to visit the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, where you can take in sweeping views of the city and marvel at the engineering feat that has become a symbol of San Francisco. For a deeper look into the city's past, the Presidio and Alcatraz Island offer insights into the military and penal history that have helped shape the city. After a day of exploring, return to the comfort of your Marriott Bonvoy accommodations, complete with modern amenities and exceptional service.

San Francisco's cultural scene is a vibrant mix of arts and culinary experiences. Explore the city's many museums, including the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA) and the Asian Art Museum, or visit the bustling Farmers' Market at the Ferry Building. For a taste of the city's famous seafood, head to Fisherman's Wharf. The city's neighborhoods, like the Mission District and Haight-Ashbury, offer a variety of street art, live music, and boutique shopping.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: San Francisco is renowned for its moderate and agreeable climate, a product of the Pacific Ocean and Bay's tempering influence. The summer months, spanning from June to August, are often characterized by a cool, foggy ambiance, with daytime temperatures hovering around the 60s and 70s Fahrenheit. The city's calendar brims with outdoor festivals and events, creating a lively backdrop for your visit. Many Marriott Bonvoy hotels in the city are appointed with cozy amenities and gracious hospitality, ensuring a delightful stay.

Winters, from December to February, are generally mild and wet, with temperatures ranging from the 50s to the low 60s Fahrenheit. The city experiences its highest rainfall during these months, but snow is rare. Spring and fall, from March to May and September to November, are perhaps the most pleasant times to visit, with clear skies, moderate temperatures in the 60s and 70s, and fewer tourists. The mild weather is perfect for exploring San Francisco’s scenic parks, walking across the Golden Gate Bridge, or enjoying a leisurely stroll through the city’s charming neighborhoods. No matter what season you visit in, Marriott Bonvoy hotels are equipped to provide a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: San Francisco International Airport is your gateway to the city, offering a myriad of transportation options for your convenience, from taxis to ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft, to the direct and efficient BART (Bay Area Rapid Transit) system. Its central location also makes it a hub for Amtrak and Caltrain services, providing a convenient rail travel option for those coming from other parts of the region. If you're driving, you'll find San Francisco's well-maintained highways and iconic bridges, like the Golden Gate Bridge and the Bay Bridge, offer scenic routes into the city.

Once in San Francisco, the city is yours to explore. The iconic San Francisco cable cars and historic streetcars are a charming way to see the sights and navigate the hilly terrain. Muni, the city’s municipal transportation system, operates buses and light rail lines that cover all major areas, making it easy to reach attractions like Fisherman’s Wharf, the Mission District, and Golden Gate Park. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available, and for those who prefer the freedom of a personal vehicle, car rental options are plentiful. Many San Francisco- area Marriot Bonvoy hotels offer onsite parking and electric car charging. San Francisco’s compact layout and pedestrian-friendly streets also make it a great city to walk or bike, so you can explore at your own pace.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: San Francisco is a city of endless fascination for children, offering a wide variety of activities to engage and inspire. Start your family adventure at the Exploratorium, a museum of science, art, and human perception with interactive exhibits and hands-on activities that will awaken your child’s curiosity. From the Tactile Dome to the Wave Organ, there are endless opportunities to engage young minds. Animal lovers will be captivated by the San Francisco Zoo, home to more than 2,000 animals from around the world. Be sure to catch the penguin feeding and visit the Lemur Forest exhibit for an unforgettable experience.

For a taste of the great outdoors, Golden Gate Park is the place to be. Explore the many gardens, rent a paddleboat and feed the ducks at Stow Lake, or visit the California Academy of Sciences. The Academy’s rainforest dome and planetarium are both educational and exciting, and the nearby de Young Museum is home to an impressive collection of art and artifacts. When it’s time to eat, San Francisco has many kid-friendly restaurants to choose from. Fisherman’s Wharf is a great place to enjoy a family meal of fresh seafood and watch the sea lions at Pier 39. With so much to see and do, San Francisco is the perfect place for a family getaway.

intro: With its sprawling metropolis famous for its iconic Hollywood sign, glittering entertainment industry, and diverse neighborhoods, Los Angeles, California, offers an endless array of experiences for every type of traveler. From the sun-soaked beaches of Santa Monica and Malibu to the vibrant streets of downtown, the city is a melting pot of cultures and lifestyles. Marriott Bonvoy’s hotels in Los Angeles provide the perfect gateway to explore these diverse attractions, ensuring a comfortable and luxurious stay. Whether you're here for business or leisure, our properties are strategically located near major landmarks, entertainment venues, and cultural hotspots, making it easy to immerse yourself in the city's dynamic energy.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: While Los Angeles is known for its vast urban sprawl, it also offers an abundance of natural beauty just a short drive or walk away. Griffith Park, one of the largest urban parks in the United States, spans over 4,000 acres and features numerous hiking trails, picnic areas, and scenic viewpoints, including the iconic Griffith Observatory. The Santa Monica Mountains, which are located just minutes from the city, provide a vast network of trails for hiking, biking, and horseback riding, as well as stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and the city skyline. The Getty Center's beautiful gardens and the Japanese Garden at the Los Angeles County Arboretum & Botanic Garden offer tranquil spots to relax and connect with nature.

Just steps from the city, the Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve beckons with its rich and varied ecosystem. It's a haven for birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts, offering a peaceful escape with walking trails and educational exhibits. And for those who love the beach, the city's coastline, stretching from Santa Monica to Manhattan Beach, is the perfect place to catch some rays, catch a wave, or just catch your breath. Whether you're up for a challenging hike or a leisurely stroll, Los Angeles has something for everyone who loves the great outdoors.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: The culture in Los Angeles is a vibrant tapestry made of its diverse communities and rich history. Staying at one of our hotels in Los Angeles places you at the epicenter of this dynamic city, where you can explore the iconic Hollywood Walk of Fame, delve into the depths of the city’s film and television legacy at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, or experience the eclectic art scene in the Arts District. Our hotels offer a perfect blend of comfort and convenience, with amenities like on-site spas, rooftop pools, and local cuisine that reflect the city’s cosmopolitan spirit.

Los Angeles is also a hub for cultural exploration beyond the glitz of the entertainment industry. Visit the Broad or the Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA) to discover world-class exhibitions and contemporary art. For a glimpse into the city’s multicultural heritage, explore the neighborhoods of Little Tokyo, Koreatown, and Boyle Heights, each offering unique dining, shopping, and cultural experiences. After a day of cultural immersion, return to your Marriott Bonvoy hotel and unwind in a serene environment that captures the essence of this eclectic metropolis.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Los Angeles is known for its Mediterranean climate, making it a great place to visit any time of year. The summer months, from June to September, are typically dry and warm, with temperatures often reaching the 80s and 90s. This is the perfect time to hit the beach, check out an outdoor festival, or enjoy the city's nightlife. While the heat can be intense, the coastal areas of the city often experience cooler temperatures in the evenings. Many Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Los Angeles, including those in the city center and near the beach, offer amenities like pools and air conditioning to help you stay cool.

Winters in Los Angeles, from December to February, are mild and relatively wet, with temperatures ranging from the 50s to 60s Fahrenheit. Rainfall is more frequent during these months, but it’s still a great time to visit, with fewer crowds and cooler temperatures ideal for sightseeing and hiking in the nearby mountains. Spring and fall, from March to May and September to November, respectively, are characterized by pleasant weather with temperatures in the 70s and 80s, making them perfect for outdoor activities and enjoying the city's numerous parks and botanical gardens.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: When you're a guest at one of our Los Angeles hotels, you have a variety of transportation options to help you explore the city's many neighborhoods and attractions. Most visitors fly into Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), one of the busiest airports in the world. From there, you can catch a taxi, use a ride-sharing app like Uber or Lyft, or take the LAX FlyAway bus service. Many of our hotels offer complimentary airport shuttle services, so be sure to check with your hotel before you arrive. Los Angeles is also accessible by train through Union Station, which connects to several major cities and serves as a hub for Amtrak and Metrolink services. Driving into LA is another option, with its extensive network of highways connecting all corners of the city.

Once in Los Angeles, you can easily get around using the Metro system, which includes bus, subway, and light rail services. It’s an affordable and efficient way to explore the city. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also widely available, providing a quick and direct way to get to your destination. If you’re staying at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel and prefer the freedom of a personal vehicle, car rental options are plentiful, and many hotels offer parking. Despite its reputation for traffic, Los Angeles has several walkable areas, such as Downtown, Hollywood, and Santa Monica, where you can easily explore on foot. No matter your preferred mode of travel, Los Angeles offers a variety of transportation options to ensure your stay is seamless and enjoyable.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Los Angeles is a haven for families, offering a vast selection of engaging and educational activities for children of all ages. Embark on your journey at the California Science Center, home to innovative exhibits like "Ecosystems" where you can explore 10 different environments from around the world. For a day of enchantment, Disneyland is the perfect destination, where children can meet beloved Disney characters, enjoy thrilling rides, and witness mesmerizing parades and shows. With accommodations near these iconic sites, you are always within reach of the excitement.

Nature enthusiasts will be captivated by the Tar Pits and Museum, where authentic mammoth fossils and the city’s ancient history come to life. The Los Angeles Zoo is another essential stop, allowing you to get close to more than 1,400 animals from across the globe, including the beloved Chimpanzees of Mahale Moutains exhibit. For a more laid-back day, Griffith Park’s vast network of trails and play areas offers ample space to stretch your legs and play. Nearby, the Griffith Observatory boasts breathtaking views and engaging exhibits on the wonders of astronomy. With so much to explore, Los Angeles is the ultimate family getaway.

intro: San Diego is a sun-soaked coastal paradise that beckons year-round, offering an irresistible mix of leisure and excitement. With its famous beaches, from the serene La Jolla Cove to the lively shores of Coronado, the city is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, boasting activities like surfing, kayaking, and hiking in the Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve. The historic Gaslamp Quarter is a hub of entertainment, with its architectural charm and vibrant nightlife, while Balboa Park stands as a cultural treasure trove, home to numerous museums, gardens, and performance spaces. Our Marriott Bonvoy San Diego hotels are strategically placed to keep you close to the city's finest attractions and conveniences, ensuring a stay that is both comfortable and connected. They also offer a range of amenities to enhance your stay, including complimentary Wi-Fi, fitness centers, and family-friendly options.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: San Diego is a perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, with its picturesque beaches, verdant parks, and diverse natural scenery. Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve, a mere drive from the city, showcases awe-inspiring coastal cliffs and unspoiled beaches, inviting you to explore over 8,000 acres of protected land. For a more relaxed outing, the iconic Balboa Park beckons with its 1,200 acres of greenery, encompassing exquisite gardens, meandering paths, and open spaces ideal for a tranquil picnic or a leisurely day out.

If you’re a water baby, San Diego’s got you covered. La Jolla Cove is a local favorite for its clear waters and rich marine life, perfect for snorkeling, diving, and swimming. Mission Bay Park is the largest aquatic park of its kind, offering a wide range of activities from paddleboarding and kayaking to jet skiing and sailing. Whether you’re looking for an adrenaline rush or a peaceful moment, San Diego’s natural beauty is sure to leave you feeling refreshed and inspired.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: San Diego's culture is a rich blend, with each community adding its own unique thread to the local way of life. Our hotels in San Diego are perfectly placed for you to explore the historic Gaslamp Quarter, with its Victorian architecture and vibrant nightlife, or to discover the city's past in Old Town, the birthplace of San Diego. Visit the San Diego Museum of Art to see a collection that spans centuries and continents, or the Museum of Contemporary Art to see the latest cutting-edge works from today's most influential artists. After a day of discovery, return to the comfort of your Marriott Bonvoy hotel and relax with modern amenities and stunning views.

San Diego’s culinary landscape is a reflection of its rich cultural tapestry, with a plethora of international flavors to savor in every district. From the fresh, farm-to-table offerings of Little Italy to the authentic Mexican fare of Barrio Logan, each bite tells a story of the city's diverse heritage. Art aficionados will revel in the monthly Art Walk of the East Village, where galleries throw open their doors to the public, and the annual San Diego International Film Festival, a gathering of filmmakers and cinephiles celebrating the magic of the silver screen. Whether you’re savoring a meal or soaking in the city's cultural offerings, San Diego's vibrant ambiance is certain to make a lasting impression.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: San Diego is celebrated for its Mediterranean climate, boasting nearly year-round sunshine and balmy temperatures. The summer months, spanning from June to September, are a delightful mix of warmth and dryness, with the mercury hovering between the mid-70s to low 80s Fahrenheit. This idyllic weather beckons you to the beach and to explore the great outdoors. Rest assured, the coastal breeze ensures a pleasant ambiance, and our Marriott Bonvoy hotels are primed with amenities like pools and beachfront access to help you savor the sunny days to the fullest.

San Diego's winters are mild and relatively wet, with temperatures typically between 50 and 70 degrees Fahrenheit. This season is perfect for those who prefer cooler weather but still want to enjoy outdoor activities. Spring and fall, from March to May and September to November, are particularly pleasant, with mild temperatures and clear skies, perfect for exploring the city's many parks, gardens, and cultural attractions. Whether you visit during the vibrant spring blooms or the warm fall days, our San Diego hotels provide the perfect base to experience all that the city has to offer.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: For those visiting San Diego, you’ll find a variety of transportation options to help you get to and from the city’s most popular attractions near Marriott Bonvoy’s San Diego hotels. The majority of visitors fly into San Diego International Airport, one of the country’s smallest and most efficient major airports. From there, you can take a taxi, use a ride-sharing service, or take advantage of your San Diego hotel’s complimentary shuttle service. Traveling by train or bus is also convenient with Amtrak and Greyhound. If you’re driving, the city is easily accessible from the highway.

Once in San Diego, you have a variety of options for getting around the city. The San Diego Trolley provides efficient and scenic transportation through downtown, the beach areas, and nearby neighborhoods. The MTS bus system also offers extensive coverage and frequent service. Taxis and ride-sharing services are widely available for quick and direct travel, and many Marriott Bonvoy hotels are located in highly walkable areas. If you prefer the flexibility of a car, rental options are plentiful and can be arranged at the airport or in various locations throughout the city.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: San Diego is a paradise for families looking to create unforgettable memories. Start with a visit to the San Diego Zoo, where your little ones can explore and learn about a vast array of animals from around the world. The zoo’s interactive exhibits, such as the Elephant Odyssey and the Polar Bear Plunge, are sure to captivate both the young and the young at heart. For a splash of fun, head over to the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, where you can take a tram ride through the vast open habitats and witness wildlife in a more natural setting.

When you're ready for some beach time, San Diego's beautiful coastline offers plenty of kid-friendly spots. La Jolla Cove's clear waters and marine life are perfect for snorkeling and tide pool exploration. If you prefer a more relaxed day, Coronado Beach provides soft sands and gentle waves, ideal for building sandcastles and playing in the surf. For a unique experience, the USS Midway Museum offers interactive exhibits and the chance to climb aboard one of the longest-serving aircraft carriers in the U.S. Navy, making it a hit with both history buffs and aspiring sailors.

intro: Miami, the vibrant coastal metropolis, is a fusion of cultures, cuisines, and lifestyles that make it a uniquely perfect destination for a trip. Known for its stunning beaches, such as South Beach, and the iconic Miami Beach Architectural District, the city offers a blend of sun-soaked relaxation and energetic nightlife. Marriott Bonvoy’s Miami hotels provide the ideal base for your adventures, with easy access to top attractions like the Wynwood Walls, the Design District, and the Biscayne NP. Whether you're here for a beach vacation, a cultural exploration, or a business meeting, the city’s diverse neighborhoods and world-class amenities ensure a seamless and enjoyable stay.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Miami is a haven for those who appreciate the great outdoors, with its verdant tropical settings and lively ecosystems. Biscayne Bay, an extensive aquatic wonderland, invites you to enjoy kayaking, paddleboarding, and snorkeling amidst mangroves and coral reefs. A short drive away, the Everglades Safari Park beckon with their airboat tours and bird-watching excursions, offering a glimpse of the city's untamed beauty. If you prefer to stay on land, the Miami Beach Boardwalk is a delightful choice, meandering through the city and granting stunning views of the ocean and the skyline.

Miami’s commitment to preserving natural beauty is evident in its parks. Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden is a serene 83-acre paradise of rare tropical plants, palms, and flowering trees. Matheson Hammock Park is a picturesque spot to sunbathe, picnic, or swim in the man-made atoll pool. Whether you’re seeking outdoor adventure or a peaceful retreat, Miami’s natural attractions are sure to inspire and rejuvenate you.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: Miami's cultural tapestry, woven with Latin, Caribbean, and American threads, is a vibrant and unique experience. Staying at one of our hotels in Miami places you at the heart of this dynamic mix, where the streets resonate with the beats of salsa and reggaeton, and the aromas of tropical cuisine waft through the air. Discover the city's artistic soul at the Wynwood Walls, a neighborhood that's a canvas for colorful street art and home to cutting-edge galleries. Miami's rich cultural tapestry is on full display in its many neighborhoods, each with its own unique character and traditions.

A visit to Little Havana offers a taste of Cuban culture, where you can savor a traditional cup of café con leche and watch locals play dominoes in the park. In contrast, the Art Deco Historic District in South Beach provides a glimpse into the city’s glamorous past, with its pastel-hued buildings and vintage allure. Whether you're exploring museums, taking in live performances, or simply strolling through the streets, Miami's culture is certain to make a lasting impression. After a day of cultural exploration, retreat to the comfort of your Marriott Bonvoy hotel, where ocean views, rooftop bars, and spa services await to pamper the discerning traveler.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Miami's tropical climate promises sun-drenched days, creating an idyllic backdrop for beachside relaxation or outdoor adventures. The summer months, spanning from June to August, deliver balmy temperatures, often peaking in the mid-80s to low 90s Fahrenheit, with the occasional afternoon thunderstorm to cool things down. Opting for a stay at a Marriott Bonvoy property with a pool or beach access is the perfect way to savor these sultry days.

Miami's winter is a delightful escape, with temperatures hovering around the 70s. Fall and spring, from September to November and March to May, offer a comfortable range from the 70s to the mid-80s, perfect for exploring the city's vibrant neighborhoods, savoring outdoor dining, and taking leisurely strolls by the beach. Miami's climate ensures that every season is a great time to visit, and Marriott Bonvoy's Miami hotels are ready to cater to your needs, whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: Miami International Airport, one of the world's busiest airports, is your gateway to the city, with a wide range of domestic and international flights. Once you land, you'll find plenty of transportation options, from taxis to ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft, to the plethora of Miami Airport shuttles, which connects to key areas across the city. Many Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Miami also offer airport shuttles, making your arrival and departure as seamless as possible. If you're driving to Miami, you'll find that the city is easily accessible by major highways and interstates. And if you're traveling by train or bus, Amtrak and Greyhound both offer regular services to Miami.

Once you're in Miami, you'll find it's easy to get around. The Miami-Dade Transit system operates buses and the Metrorail, which can take you to most major neighborhoods and attractions quickly and affordably. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also widely available, and many travelers choose to rent a car. Car rental companies are located at Miami International Airport and throughout the city, and parking is available at most hotels. Whether you prefer to take public transportation, drive or walk, Miami makes it easy to explore the city on your own terms.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Miami is a vibrant playground for families, offering an array of kid-friendly activities that will keep children entertained and engaged. Start your adventure at the Miami Children’s Museum, where interactive exhibits like the KidSmart and the Music and Movement Center encourage learning through play. For a closer look at marine life, head to the Miami Seaquarium, where kids can watch dolphins, sea lions, and killer whales perform in thrilling shows, or even participate in a behind-the-scenes tour to meet some of the park’s residents. With our conveniently located hotels, you’ll always be a short distance from these exciting attractions.

For a more natural and outdoor experience, the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens is a must-see. The sprawling gardens and hidden play areas are perfect for exploring and using your imagination. If you’re looking for a more active adventure, the Miami Beach Boardwalk is a great place to start. The scenic path is perfect for biking, rollerblading, or a leisurely walk, with plenty of places to stop and play along the way. After a day of fun, relax and enjoy some family-friendly dining at one of the many kid-friendly restaurants in the area.

intro: Orlando is a city bursting with life, a top choice for travelers with its renowned theme parks such as Walt Disney World, Universal Studios, and SeaWorld. Marriott Bonvoy’s Orlando hotels are strategically placed to offer you easy access to these top draws, ensuring your stay is brimming with both thrills and relaxation. Whether your journey is for business or leisure, our hotels are equipped with a host of amenities to make your stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Orlando is a city that has it all, from vibrant urban attractions to beautiful natural landscapes. If you love the outdoors, you'll be in your element here. Wekiwa Springs State Park is a must-see, with its crystal-clear springs, dense forests, and a range of activities such as swimming, canoeing, and hiking. The park's peaceful trails and waterways are the perfect antidote to city life, offering a chance to relax and reconnect with nature. If you're a wildlife enthusiast, the Audubon Center for Birds of Prey is a great place to visit. Here, you can learn about and observe a variety of raptors in their natural habitat.

A mere stone's throw from the heart of Orlando, the Orlando Wetlands Park is a sprawling 1,600-acre sanctuary. Its trails and boardwalks meander through lush wetlands, home to hundreds of bird species and an abundance of native plants and animals. Whether you're a seasoned nature enthusiast or a casual wanderer, the park's varied landscapes and rich wildlife offer endless opportunities for relaxation and discovery. After a day of outdoor exploration, return to the comfort and luxury of one of Marriott Bonvoy’s Orlando hotels.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: Orlando's culture is a colorful tapestry woven from a rich mix of creativity, history, and innovation. Beyond its world-class theme parks, the city is home to a vibrant arts scene, featuring galleries, theaters, and live performances to suit every taste. Marriott Bonvoy's hotels in Orlando offer not only the comfort and luxury you expect but also convenient access to cultural highlights like the Orlando Museum of Art, where you can explore a wide-ranging collection of American and European art, as well as contemporary works by local artists. After a day of cultural discovery, relax in the tranquil and stylish setting of your Marriott Bonvoy accommodations, complete with modern amenities and impeccable service.

Orlando’s diverse neighborhoods contribute to its cultural richness, each with its own unique vibe and charm. From the trendy Ivanhoe Village with its indie music and art scene to the historic Church Street District with its Victorian-era architecture and vintage shops, there’s something for everyone. The city’s annual festivals, such as the Orlando Fringe Festival and the Orlando International Film Festival, showcase local and international talent, making Orlando an exciting, ever-changing cultural hub.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Orlando basks in a warm and humid subtropical climate, making it an ideal year-round destination for travelers. The summer months, from June to August, are sizzling with average temperatures often reaching the 90s, accompanied by high humidity. Afternoon thunderstorms are frequent during this season, providing a refreshing break from the heat and contributing to the city's lush green landscapes. Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Orlando are equipped with an array of amenities, including pools and air-conditioned rooms, to ensure your comfort and coolness.

Winters in Orlando are mild, with temperatures typically ranging from the 60s to the 70s during the day, and cooler evenings in the 40s to 50s. This season is ideal for outdoor activities and exploring the city's numerous attractions without the intense heat. Spring and Fall, from March to May and September to November, bring pleasant weather with temperatures averaging in the 70s to 80s, perfect for enjoying the city's natural beauty. Whether you visit during the warm, sunny days of Spring or the cooler, comfortable nights of Fall, Orlando’s climate ensures a delightful experience.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: When you visit Orlando, you have a variety of transportation options to choose from to make your trip as seamless as possible. If you prefer to use public transportation, the Lynx bus system provides extensive coverage throughout the city and connects to major areas and attractions.

Upon arrival in Orlando, the SunRail commuter rail service offers a convenient, scenic way to travel between downtown and key locations. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available for a more direct and flexible mode of transportation. If you prefer to explore the city and its surroundings on your own terms, renting a car is a popular choice and provides easy access to all of Orlando’s attractions and beyond. Whichever mode of transportation you choose, Orlando’s well-connected infrastructure ensures you can easily reach all of the city’s exciting destinations and Marriott Bonvoy properties.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Orlando is a dream destination for families, with enough entertainment to keep the kids happy for your whole stay. Start with a visit to the world-renowned theme parks, where you can explore magical kingdoms, experience thrilling rides, and meet beloved characters. For a more laid-back adventure, head to the Orlando Science Center, where interactive exhibits and hands-on activities make learning fun. The DinoDigs outdoor fossil pit and the KidsTown exhibit are sure to be highlights for young explorers.

Nature enthusiasts will be drawn to the Central Florida Zoo & Botanical Gardens, home to a diverse range of animals and lush plant life. The little ones will be thrilled with the petting zoo, splash pads, and the Discovery Center's educational programs and close animal encounters. After a day of discovery, you can cool off at one of the city's water parks, such as Aquatica or Disney’s Typhoon Lagoon, offering water slides, lazy rivers, and wave pools for endless family fun. With Marriott Bonvoy’s prime locations, you're just a short drive away from these incredible family-friendly attractions.

intro: Fort Lauderdale, a city that lives up to its reputation as the "Venice of America," is a dynamic coastal gem with an extensive canal system. Its 23 miles of beaches are a sun-soaked paradise, perfect for swimming and water sports. The city's downtown area is a hub of high-end shopping, art, and exciting nightlife, while the historic Las Olas Boulevard offers a charming stroll past upscale eateries and cafes. Beyond the city's limits, nature beckons with lush parks and the famous Everglades, just a short drive away. Whether you seek relaxation or adventure, our Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Fort Lauderdale offer the perfect starting point for your journey, with a variety of amenities and services to elevate your experience.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Fort Lauderdale is a haven for nature lovers, boasting vast beaches and verdant parks that offer a serene contrast to the urban landscape. The renowned Fort Lauderdale Beach beckons, with its 7-mile stretch of sun-drenched sand, inviting you to relax, swim, or partake in a game of beach volleyball. For a more intimate encounter with nature, the Hugh Taylor Birch State Park presents a peaceful beachfront, complete with mangrove forests and an abundance of wildlife, ideal for a leisurely stroll or a waterside picnic.

The city’s extensive canal system, often referred to as the “Venice of America,” is a haven for nature lovers. Paddle through the calm waters in a kayak or canoe and explore the mangrove tunnels, keeping an eye out for native birds and marine life. The Fort Lauderdale Arboretum is a hidden gem, home to over 100 species of trees and plants, and offers a peaceful setting for nature walks and photography. Whether you’re in search of sun, sand, or greenery, Fort Lauderdale’s natural beauty offers endless opportunities for outdoor adventure and relaxation.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: Fort Lauderdale is a city that celebrates the arts, history, and the great outdoors. The city’s historic districts, like Las Olas Boulevard and Riverwalk, are filled with unique shops, art galleries, and restaurants. The Museum of Art + Design at NSU Art Museum Fort Lauderdale is a great place to see contemporary art and design. The African-American Research Library and Cultural Center is a place to learn about the contributions of African Americans through exhibits and events. Whether you’re exploring the Arts & Entertainment District or catching a show at the Broward Center for the Performing Arts, you’re sure to be inspired.

Fort Lauderdale is also known for its lively festivals and events that bring the community together. The annual Fort Lauderdale International Film Festival attracts cinephiles from around the globe, offering a diverse array of films and documentaries. For a taste of the city's culinary culture, the Taste of Fort Lauderdale event is a must-attend, featuring local chefs and restaurants showcasing their best dishes. These events, combined with the city's year-round sun and beach lifestyle, create a dynamic and welcoming atmosphere for visitors to explore and enjoy.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Fort Lauderdale, with its tropical climate, promises warm and welcoming weather throughout the year. Summers, from June to August, are hot and humid, with temperatures averaging from the mid-80s to low 90s Fahrenheit. Afternoons often bring brief, refreshing showers or thunderstorms, which can be the perfect time to relax in the city's beaches and pools. Many of our Marriott Bonvoy hotels offer luxurious amenities to ensure your comfort and coolness.

Winters, from December to February, are mild and dry, with temperatures typically in the 70s during the day and cooling off to the 60s at night. This season is particularly popular for visitors seeking a warm escape, as the pleasant weather is ideal for exploring the city’s outdoor attractions and enjoying the vibrant nightlife. Spring and Fall, from March to May and September to November, offer a comfortable balance with temperatures ranging from the 70s to the 80s, making it perfect for sightseeing and outdoor activities. Whether you visit in the height of summer or the mild winter, Fort Lauderdale’s climate ensures a delightful stay.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: When you're ready to explore Fort Lauderdale, you'll find a wealth of transportation options at your fingertips. Most visitors arrive via Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, where taxis, ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft, and airport shuttles are all available. If you prefer to travel by land, the city is also accessible via Amtrak and Greyhound bus services. Plus, Fort Lauderdale is easy to reach by car, thanks to its proximity to major highways. No matter how you choose to travel, you'll find that getting to and around Fort Lauderdale is a breeze.

Once you're in Fort Lauderdale, you'll find it easy to get around the city. The Broward County Transit system is a convenient way to travel, with bus services and the Sun Trolley, which is a great way to see the sights. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also widely available, and car rental companies can be found at the airport and throughout the city. The downtown area of Fort Lauderdale is compact and easy to navigate, making it a great place to explore on foot. And with so many options for getting around, you'll be able to make the most of your time in the city.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: For families, Fort Lauderdale is a treasure trove of unforgettable experiences. Kick off your journey at the Museum of Discovery and Science, where little ones can immerse themselves in everything from simulated space travel to the magic of the Everglades. A trip to the Sawgrass Mills Outlet Mall is also a must, with its fantastic shopping, top-tier indoor play area, and ice rink for skating. Our city-center hotels place you mere moments from these attractions.

For families that love the great outdoors, Fort Lauderdale’s beaches are a slice of paradise, with their soft sands and gentle waves just right for sandcastle building and paddling. The Fort Lauderdale Beach Park has a playground and a splash pad to keep the little ones entertained. Or you can explore the 35 acres of the Bonnet House Museum & Gardens, with its beautiful gardens and resident wildlife. After a day of sun and sightseeing, you can enjoy a family meal at one of the city’s many family-friendly restaurants, such as the fun Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. or the colorful Flamingo Gardens, where you can dine surrounded by tropical gardens.

intro: Key West, the southernmost city in the United States, is a tropical paradise that beckons with a unique blend of laid-back charm and vibrant energy. Known for its crystal-clear waters and breathtaking sunsets, this island city offers a myriad of activities to suit every type of traveler. From the historic Old Town's quaint streets and Victorian architecture to the bustling nightlife along Duval Street, there's always something new to discover. Marriott Bonvoy’s collection of hotels in Key West serve as the perfect launchpad to explore this idyllic destination, providing comfortable accommodations and easy access to the city's top attractions.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Key West is a haven for nature enthusiasts, offering tons of opportunity for both sea and land adventures. The city's renowned beaches, from Smathers to Higgs, beckon for sun-soaked days, swimming, and underwater explorations. Nearby, the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and abundance of marine life and the only coral barrier reef in the continental US. For a more tranquil experience, the Key West Butterfly and Nature Conservatory invites you to stroll amidst butterflies and exotic flora in a serene, indoor setting.

History buffs can explore the historic Truman Annex, home to beautiful gardens and the Truman Little White House, where President Harry S. Truman spent 175 days of his presidency. The Key West Botanical Garden is a peaceful place to enjoy native flora and fauna, have a picnic, or take a leisurely walk. Whether you’re a beach bum, a botanist, or a birdwatcher, Key West’s natural beauty provides plenty of opportunities to enjoy the great outdoors.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: The culture in Key West is a vibrant tapestry woven from the city’s storied past and its present-day laid-back charm. Marriott Bonvoy’s hotels in Key West offer a front-row seat to the island’s unique blend of artistic expression, historical landmarks, and tropical ambiance. Stroll through the streets to discover the legacy of renowned author Ernest Hemingway, visit the Key West Lighthouse to learn about the city’s maritime history, or explore the Truman Little White House for a glimpse into presidential life. After a day of cultural immersion, unwind in the comfort of your hotel with amenities like spa services, beach access, and rooftop bars that capture the essence of island living.

Key West’s artistic spirit is everywhere, from the galleries and studios showcasing local and international talent to the city’s annual events, including Fantasy Fest and the Key West Literary Seminar. For a more in-depth look at the city’s cultural offerings, take in a show at the historic Capitol Theatre or hop on a sunset cruise to experience Key West’s vibrant music and art scene in a truly magical setting.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: Imagine a place where the sun shines bright and the weather is perfect every day. Welcome to Key West, where a tropical marine climate ensures warm and delightful conditions throughout the year. Summers, from June to August, are toasty and humid, with temperatures typically in the mid-80s to low 90s. Afternoon showers and thunderstorms are common, offering a welcome respite from the heat. Our Marriott Bonvoy hotels are ready to welcome you with well-appointed rooms, air conditioning, and refreshing pools, providing the ideal escape during the warmest months.

The winter months, from December to February, are mild and dry, with temperatures ranging from the mid-70s to the low 80s Fahrenheit. This is the most popular time to visit, as the weather is ideal for exploring the city’s numerous outdoor activities and attractions. Spring and fall, from March to May and September to November, offer comfortable temperatures in the 70s to 80s, making these seasons perfect for enjoying the beaches and scenic walks. With its consistent warmth and sunshine, Key West is a delightful destination no matter when you choose to visit.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: For those traveling by air, Key West International Airport is just a short distance from the city center and offers a range of flights to and from most major cities. Upon arrival, you can easily hail a taxi, book a ride with Uber or Lyft, or rent a car to take you to your choice of Marriott Bonvoy hotels. If you're driving, the Overseas Highway is a beautiful and convenient way to reach the island, connecting Key West to the mainland and other keys along the route. And for a truly unique experience, consider arriving by ferry, which allows you to bring your car or simply sit back and enjoy the scenic journey.

Once in Key West, you'll find a compact and charming city that's a joy to explore on foot, especially in the historic Old Town area where many top attractions and hotels are located. For longer distances or to explore further afield, bicycles are a popular and eco-friendly option, with many bike rental shops available. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily accessible. For a unique experience, consider hopping on a golf cart or a moped, both of which are common and fun ways to navigate the city's laid-back streets.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Key West is a family paradise where you can explore the magic of the tropics. For a memorable experience, take a ride on the Conch Train Tour, which provides a narrated journey through the city’s historic neighborhoods, sharing fun facts and offbeat stories that will keep young minds entertained. The train’s open-air cars offer an unobstructed view of the lively streets and famous sites, making it an adventure they’ll never forget.

When the sun is high and the energy is flowing, head to Higgs Beach for some beachside fun. The soft sands and shallow waters are ideal for building sandcastles and splashing around, while the playground and splash pad offer plenty of entertainment for all ages. For a touch of adventure, take the family to the Key West Shipwreck Museum, where they can discover the thrilling history of shipwrecks. Don’t miss the chance to pan for treasure and take home a piece of the city’s maritime past. With so much to see and do, Key West is the perfect destination for a family vacation.

intro: Tampa, a city that effortlessly marries the allure of the coast with the sophistication of urban living. The waterfront, with its celebrated Tampa Riverwalk, is a focal point, linking cultural gems such as the Florida Aquarium and the Tampa Museum of Art. Sports enthusiasts will be in their element at the Raymond James Stadium and Amalie Arena, while those with a penchant for nature can immerse themselves in the nearby Hillsborough River State Park or opt for a boat tour to encounter the local wildlife. To step back in time and savor the city's rich history, a stroll through the historic district of Ybor City is a must, where the legacy of cigar manufacturing and the influence of Spanish, Cuban, and Italian immigrants are still palpable.

explore.label: Nature
paragraphs: Tampa is a haven for nature enthusiasts, with a plethora of outdoor spaces to suit every taste. The city's showpiece, Lettuce Lake Park, spans over 67 acres of unspoiled wetlands and forested trails, perfect for a morning stroll or a bike ride. If you're keen on exploring the local wildlife and marine life, the Florida Aquarium beckons with its interactive displays and conservation initiatives. A short drive away, Hillsborough River State Park awaits with its tranquil waters and verdant woodlands, inviting you to kayak, canoe, or simply relax with a picnic.

If you prefer a more urban outdoor experience, the Tampa Riverwalk is a beautiful, 2.6-mile path that runs along the Hillsborough River and connects some of the city’s best attractions. The Riverwalk is lined with public art, beautiful landscaping, and plenty of places to sit and enjoy the water. For a unique mix of art and nature, the Tampa Museum of Art has a stunning outdoor sculpture garden with views of the river. Whether you’re an experienced hiker or just want to spend a day outside, Tampa has a variety of outdoor activities to enjoy.

explore.label: Culture
paragraphs: Tampa is a city that has a little something for everyone, thanks to its rich history and diverse communities. When you stay at one of our hotels in Tampa, you'll be right in the heart of the action. The Ybor City Historic District, once known for its Cuban immigrant population and cigar factories, is now a bustling neighborhood with historic buildings, vibrant nightlife, and a variety of dining options. The Tampa Museum of Art is a must-see, with its collection of contemporary and ancient art. And the nearby Channelside District and Water Street Tampa offer a mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

Tampa’s cultural tapestry is deeply intertwined with its natural beauty. The city's commitment to its waterfront has given rise to stunning parks and outdoor spaces like Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park and the Tampa Riverwalk, which link the city's cultural landmarks and offer breathtaking bay views. Wander through the distinct neighborhoods, from the bohemian Seminole Heights to the vibrant Downtown area, and immerse yourself in the community's spirit through its festivals, markets, and year-round events.

explore.label: Climate
paragraphs: With its humid subtropical climate, Tampa is the perfect place to enjoy warm weather year-round. Summer (June to August) is hot and humid with average high temperatures in the upper 80s to low 90s°F. Afternoon thunderstorms are common, and the city can experience the occasional tropical storm. The rain helps keep Tampa green and lush. Our hotels in Tampa have everything you need to beat the heat, from air-conditioned rooms to refreshing pools.

Winters are mild in Tampa, with temperatures typically ranging from the mid-60s to low 70s Fahrenheit during the day. Evenings can be cooler, with temperatures dropping to the 50s, but snow is virtually unheard of. Fall and spring, from September to November and March to May, respectively, offer daytime temperatures in the 70s to 80s, making it an ideal time to explore the city's diverse neighborhoods, scenic waterfronts, and outdoor attractions. Whether you're visiting in the cooler or warmer months, Tampa's climate is sure to make your stay enjoyable and memorable.

explore.label: Transport
paragraphs: Tampa is a city with a wealth of transportation options, making it easy for you to get around and explore from any of Marriott Bonvoy’s Tampa hotels. Tampa International Airport is the area’s major airport, with a variety of ground transportation options to get you to your hotel, including taxis, ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft, and a few hotels that offer complimentary shuttle services. If you’re arriving by train, Amtrak stops at Tampa’s Union Station, and the city is also served by Greyhound bus services. Tampa is easily accessible by car, with major highways like Interstate 275 and the Lee Roy Selmon Expressway, and there are plenty of rental car agencies at the airport and throughout the city.

Once you're in Tampa, you can easily get around using the Hillsborough Area Regional Transit (HART) system, which includes buses and the TECO Line Streetcar, connecting popular areas such as Ybor City, Channel District, and the Riverwalk. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also widely available for quick and direct transportation. If you prefer the convenience of a personal vehicle, car rentals are a great option, and many hotels offer secure on-site parking. Downtown Tampa is very walkable, and many attractions are within easy reach from our Marriott Bonvoy’s hotels in the city center. Whether you're heading to the beach or exploring the downtown area, Tampa’s transportation options are designed to make your trip easy.

explore.label: Kids
paragraphs: Tampa is a goldmine of entertainment for the young ones, boasting a wide range of attractions that are sure to please all ages. The Florida Aquarium is a definite highlight, offering a chance for kids to discover the magic of the underwater world, from vibrant coral reefs to the antics of penguins. Interactive exhibits such as the Stingray Touch Tank and the Splash Pad ensure that learning is fun and hands-on. For an action-packed day, Busch Gardens Tampa is the place to be, with a mix of thrilling rides, captivating live shows, and opportunities for animal encounters up close. The Hippo Theater and the Cheetah Hunt are just a taste of the excitement that awaits.

The Tampa Museum of Art and the Glazer Children’s Museum are also must-see attractions. The art museum has a collection of Greek and Roman antiquities, as well as contemporary art and interactive displays. The children’s museum has a variety of exhibits, including the Construction Zone and the Water Ways exhibit, which teaches kids about the city’s water systems. Lowry Park is a great place to spend the day outdoors. It has a zoo, botanical gardens, and splash pads. And no family vacation is complete without a stop at Mr. Chilly for some ice cream.
